methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The objectives of this research were to develop the criteria and indicators used as the guidelines for school administrators in energy management and conservation, and to assess their energy performances

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a qualitative energy-management framework (9 criteria and 25 indicators scored 1-5 with maturity interpretation levels) for schools; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised. Energy performance is assessed through management-quality scoring by auditors and raw year-over-year electricity (kWh) comparison, with no normalisation variables, functional form, or baseline-model construction/estimation approach. This is a framework/maturity assessment without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The Development of Criteria and Indicators for Energy Management of Educational Institutions with the Energy Management System

stage1.notes: 'Indicators' are energy-management practice indicators, not EnPI/EnB models; energy performance shown only as raw kWh year-over-year change. Framework piloted in 3 schools (multi-case).
